title: Listening Is an Expression of Love
headline: Why Being a Good Listener Takes Humility
tagline: People rarely open their hearts where they feel judged. They open them where they feel heard.
seo_title: Why Listening Takes Humility: Proverbs 18:13 Group Questions | TheWrkShop
seo_description: People don't remember perfect advice; they remember feeling understood. Reflection and men's group questions on listening, pride and Proverbs 18:13.
verse_text: To answer before listening, that is folly and shame.

scriptures.text: To answer before listening, that is folly and shame.

items: Jesus asked hundreds of questions throughout His ministry.
Why?
Because great teachers don’t merely provide answers.
They awaken hearts.
Jesus listened beyond words.
He heard fear.
He heard pride.
He heard shame.
He heard faith.
He heard what no one else noticed.
Listening is one of the purest expressions of love.
People often don’t remember the perfect advice.
They remember feeling understood.
That requires humility.
Humility asks another question.
Pride assumes it already knows.
When someone disagrees with me….
Do I become defensive…. or curious?
Curiosity often reveals humility.
Defensiveness often reveals insecurity.
Why is listening becoming increasingly difficult in today’s culture?
How does pride interfere with our ability to truly hear others?
Describe someone who made you feel deeply heard. What made them different?
When have you sensed God speaking most clearly in your life?
How would becoming a better listener change your marriage, parenting, friendships or leadership?
What area of your life might God still be trying to teach you?
People rarely open their hearts where they feel judged.
They often open them where they feel heard.

blocks.text: Following Jesus means loving truth more than winning arguments.
